text.p: Hybridon Inc said on Monday it received two U.S. Patents claiming chemically advanced mixed backbone oligonucleotides that will be used in antisense drugs that target viruses and cancer.

U.S. Patent No. 5,652,355 claims as compositions of matter mixed backbone "hybrid" oligonucleotides, which are second generation chemistries on modified genetic material that have been found to be more effective than earlier versions of antisense drugs.
Antisense drugs are drugs that use synthetic segments of nucleic acid that are designed to treat disease.

"These two composition of matter chemistry patents, when coupled with our recently issued patent for oral delivery, confirm and strengthen Hybridon's leadership position in the race for new and improved antisense chemistries," Hybridon chairman and chief executive E. Andrews Grinstead said in a statement.
Hybridon said it plans to exploit these patents itself and to seek attractive licensing-out opportunities.
